channel.title: Practices on P-SSCRM: Proactive Secure Software Supply Chain Risk Management
channel.description: Recent content in Practices on P-SSCRM: Proactive Secure Software Supply Chain Risk Management

item.title: Develop security requirements
item.description: The development of software-related objectives and expectations to protect the service and data at the core of the application.

item.title: Identify SSC Control Gaps
item.description: Identify controls that have not been recorded in one or more SSC frameworks.

item.title: Perform compliance
item.description: Compliance is following established guidelines or specifications, possibly demonstrated through an audit.

item.title: Respond to/disclose vulnerabilities
item.description: Controls for identifying and addressing vulnerabilities in products and preventing similar ones from occuring in the future.

item.title: Safeguard artifact integrity
item.description: Protect from unauthorized or accidental access and alteration of project artifacts.

item.title: Build security in
item.description: Use software development practices and processes that will lead to the development of secure software products.

item.title: Develop security policies
item.description: Establishing organizational roles and controls for driving internal security standards in alignment with the business purpose of the organization.

item.title: Monitor intrusions/violations
item.description: Controls for identifying malicious activity at runtime.

item.title: Safeguard build integrity
item.description: Protect from and detect malicious infiltration into software build infrastructure that could lead to the build and deployment of compromised products.

item.title: Manage component and container choices
item.description: Software supply chain risk can be reduced by careful choice and handling of third-party components and containers.

item.title: Manage suppliers
item.description: Controls to require that third-party suppliers employ adequate security measures to protect information, applications, AI models, and services provided to the organization.

item.title: Secure software development environment
item.description: Protect the software development environment from internal and external threats that can lead to compromise.

item.title: Discover vulnerabilities
item.description: Use automated and manual vulnerability discovery techniques to identify previously-undisclosed vulnerabilities in in-house and third-party code, including AI models.

item.title: Training
item.description: Educating all personnel in role-specific information about the secure software development, including awareness, technical skills, and emergency response.

item.title: Assess and manage risk
item.description: Proactively analyzing, mitigating, and managing software supply chain risk and achieving the objectives of a software security program.

item.title: Manage vulnerable components and containers
item.description: Develop and implement a strategy for patching/upgrading components and containers to the latest secure version.
